statement.en: From a local law and a list of exchanges a World of the spine is built whose steps balance. For any two interleavings of the same own courses an index map for each relatum matches its standings step by step, so what is read through its own steps is the same for every interleaving.
statement.zh: 由局部律与交换之列构造出脊柱的一个世界，其各步平衡。对同一自身进程的任意两个交错，每个关系项的索引映射逐步相配其所立，所以经其自身各步读出者对每个交错都相同。

laws.en: The configuration after the first t exchanges of a list changes across step t by the exchange at t, is the whole list's from its length on, is unchanged up to a list's length by appending, is after a list the rest's from where the list ends, and agrees where the starts agree.
laws.zh: 一列交换的前 t 个之后的构形，跨第 t 步按第 t 个交换改变，从列长起是整列之构形，到列长为止不因追加而变，一列之后是余下者从该列终点出发的构形，起点一致则一致。

laws.en: The world of a local law on whole-number standings, the relata listed, a list and a start: at step t each relatum stands where the first t exchanges leave it, is active where the exchange at t touches it, and the move at t has present the listed relata it touches, each taking its fall and giving its rise; nothing is required, needed or drawn.
laws.zh: 整数所立上的局部律、所列关系项、交换之列与起点的世界：在第 t 步每个关系项立于前 t 个交换使它所在之处，被第 t 个交换触及处为活跃，第 t 步之动在场者为它触及的所列关系项，各取其降、给其升；无所求、所需或所汲。

laws.en: With every relatum listed once, every step of the world balances: the standing after the step with what the relatum took is the standing before with what it gave.
laws.zh: 每个关系项恰列一次时，世界每一步都平衡：步后所立加所取，等于步前所立加所给。

laws.en: A relatum's course of standings is its standing after each exchange of its own course, in order. Moving an exchange forward past exchanges sharing no relatum with it keeps every course of standings, so with the relata listed two lists giving every relatum the same own course, and two interleavings of the same courses, give every relatum the same course of standings.
laws.zh: 关系项的一串所立，是它在自身进程的每个交换之后依次所立。把一个交换前移越过与它不共享关系项的交换，保持每串所立；所以关系项列出时，给每个关系项同一自身进程的两列，以及同一进程的两个交错，给每个关系项同一串所立。

laws.en: With the relata listed, the worlds of two lists giving every relatum the same own course stand alike at every step from both lengths on.
laws.zh: 关系项列出时，给每个关系项同一自身进程的两列，其世界从两者长度起每一步所立相同。

laws.en: Two adjacent exchanges sharing no relatum, taken in either order, leave the worlds alike at every step but the one between them; there a relatum the first touches stands, in the world taking it first, where it stands after both in the other, and where it stood before both in the other; one neither touches stands alike.
laws.zh: 两个相邻、不共享关系项的交换，以任一次序取用，世界在它们之间那一步以外每步相同；在那一步，先取第一个交换的世界中，它触及的关系项立于另一世界两者之后所立处，另一世界中则立于两者之前；两者都不触及者相同。

laws.en: A relatum's standing at step t of a list is its standing after the own exchanges the first t exchanges hold (ownCount, standingAfter). So in two interleavings of the same courses, with the relata listed, a relatum stands alike at any two steps, one in each world, at which it has taken equally many of its own exchanges.
laws.zh: 关系项在一列的第 t 步所立，是它在前 t 个交换所含的自身交换之后所立（ownCount、standingAfter）。所以关系项列出时，在同一进程的两个交错中，关系项在任意两步（各在一个世界）所立相同，只要到那时它已取同样多的自身交换。

laws.en: The index map for a relatum sends a step of one list to the least step of the other at which the relatum has taken as many of its own exchanges (firstAt is that least step; ownCount_index); a relatum stands at step t of one world where it stands at the mapped step of the other. Where it takes an exchange at step t of one list, the map sends t + 1 to the step after the one at which it takes the same exchange in the other.
laws.zh: 关系项的索引映射把一列的一步送到另一列中该关系项已取同样多自身交换的最早一步（firstAt 即那最早一步；ownCount_index）；关系项在一个世界第 t 步所立，等于它在另一世界映射所给那一步所立。它在一列第 t 步取一个交换处，映射把 t + 1 送到它在另一列取同一交换那一步之后一步。

laws.en: What is read through a relatum's own steps is the same for every interleaving: for every property of a standing, a relatum has it at some step of one world exactly where at some step of the other, and at every step of one exactly where at every step of the other.
laws.zh: 经关系项自身各步读出者，对每个交错都相同：对所立的每个性质，关系项在一个世界某步具有它，恰当它在另一世界某步具有它；在一个世界每步具有，恰当在另一世界每步具有。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. A local law on whole-number standings for the world (the laws of own steps hold for any states); the relata listed, once where balance is stated; relata told apart for the move. The courses are finite lists.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。世界取整数所立上的局部律（关于自身各步的规律对任何状态成立）；关系项列出，陈述平衡处恰列一次；为动区分关系项。进程是有限列。

does_not_show.en: One renumbering of all the steps carrying one interleaving's world to the other's: the index maps are one for each relatum, and a relation reading two relata at one step of the shared index (which stand together at a step) is not shown the same for every interleaving.
does_not_show.zh: 把一个交错之世界带到另一个之世界的、所有步的单一重编号：索引映射是每个关系项各一个，读共同指标同一步上两个关系项的关系（哪些在同一步共同所立）未证对每个交错相同。

does_not_show.en: The correspondence with the footprint of Becoming.Reordering (Footprinted, Reindexes, converse): there a relatum a step does not touch is unmoved across it, activity included, while this world marks a relatum active exactly at the steps whose exchange touches it, so the footprint of the exchanges does not contain them; and Reindexes needs each exchange's occurrence matched in the two lists, which needs the maps of the relata an exchange touches to agree.
does_not_show.zh: 与 Becoming.Reordering 之足迹（Footprinted、Reindexes、converse）的对应：那里一步不触及的关系项跨此步不动，活跃也包括在内，而此世界恰在其交换触及关系项之步标其为活跃，所以交换的足迹不包含它们；且 Reindexes 需要每个交换在两列中的出现相配，这需要一个交换所触及诸关系项的映射彼此一致。

does_not_show.en: Courses without end; footprints that read relata they do not change.
does_not_show.zh: 无尽的进程；读而不改关系项的足迹。

next_delta.en: One renumbering of the steps matching each exchange's occurrence across the relata it touches; then the correspondence with Becoming.Reordering through a footprint containing the world's activity; courses without end; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 与每个交换所触及诸关系项相配其出现的单一步重编号；然后经包含世界之活跃的足迹与 Becoming.Reordering 对应；无尽的进程；独立审查。

correspondence.en: The twentieth review's G10 asked that Interleavings, which reads the step index off the relata's own courses, construct the World, so that one shared index is a reading on the premise card. Reading (the AI's): the spine's World, with its one index, is what an interleaving of the relata's own courses builds; what the interleaving adds beyond the courses moves only where exchanges share no relatum, and there each relatum stands in one world where it stands a step earlier or later in the other. With the index map (R38), what the world says of each relatum, read through its own steps, is the same for every interleaving: the premise card's one shared index (§0, block A) commits, for what is read per relatum, to no more than a choice among interleavings, which moves where on the index a standing falls and not which standings a relatum passes through or in what order. For the necessity target (the deductive necessity of the whole, item 1 of §8.1, and the representation criterion K4) this makes the shared index a reading wherever a law is read through each relatum's own steps; a law that reads several relata at one step of the index is still read on a chosen interleaving, which is what one renumbering of the steps would settle.
correspondence.zh: 第二十次审查 G10 要求从关系项自身进程读出步指标的 Interleavings 构造世界，使唯一的共同指标在前提卡上成为一个读法。读法（AI 的）：带唯一指标的脊柱世界，是关系项自身进程的一个交错所构造者；交错在进程之外所加者只在交换不共享关系项处移动，且在那里每个关系项在一个世界中立于它在另一世界早一步或晚一步所立处。有了索引映射（R38），世界关于每个关系项所说者，经其自身各步读出，对每个交错都相同：前提卡上唯一的共同指标（§0，A 区）对按关系项读出者而言，只承诺在诸交错中作一选择，这选择移动的是所立落在指标的何处，而非关系项经过哪些所立或按何次序。对必然性目标（整体的演绎必然性，§8.1 第 1 项，及表示判据 K4），这使共同指标在每条经各关系项自身各步读出的规律处成为一个读法；在指标同一步读几个关系项的规律仍在所选的交错上读出，这正是单一步重编号将解决者。

history.en: 20 October 2026, R38 (the open part of R33's G10): three laws added (the standing at a step as the standing after own exchanges, so equal own counts stand alike across interleavings; the index map, its exactness and its matching of each relatum's exchanges; the readings through own steps the same for every interleaving), the general step-by-step relation thus proved directly rather than by composing adjacent swaps; the open part restated as one renumbering of the steps and the correspondence with Reordering's footprint, with its blocker; what the relation gives the necessity target and the premise card added to the correspondence. Proof binding (Interleavings.lean) rebound to core receipt 20261020T070914.793352Z. Study section 233.
